snippet.title: Mangut - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Face the struggles of Gil, a tireless app delivery worker racing against time to pay the bills. Swing through hand-painted levels with a unique grappling hook and make tough choices in this game featuring an original soundtrack. Watch the Mangut trailer for this upcoming precision platformer to learn more about the story and get a peek at gameplay. Mangut will be available on Steam.
